name: The Black Osprey in the ledger

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic quest-chain scene; in-world date unknown

summary: At Ratchet, Dizzywig searches the port ledger and finds Velinde’s name beside passage on the Black Osprey to Booty Bay. With no contrary entry, he assumes the vessel arrived safely. That is a reasonable reading of a dock record, but it is still an inference by the wharfmaster; Velinde leaves no message from the far shore. The harbor narrows the search to a named crossing and a likely destination, then hands the question to a caravaner who may remember what happened after the ship berthed.
